phases.label: Constitution
phases.note: Establish immutable architectural principles that guide all development.

phases.label: Specify
phases.note: Define requirements and user stories — intent as the source of truth.

phases.label: Implement
phases.note: Execute the tasks to build the feature.

scenarios.note: Must use the **/speckit.clarify workaround** — specify wants to create a new feature. Regenerates plan + tasks.
Constitution-driven governance. The full pipeline is **purpose-built for 0→1**.
Update the spec, regenerate the plan. Good for medium changes with the clarify workflow.
Branch-based, **no parallel isolation**. Coordination is manual.
Must update multiple specs separately. The constitution helps consistency.

keyFeatures: 8 slash commands — constitution → specify → plan → tasks → implement (+ clarify, analyze, checklist)
Agent-agnostic — works with 15+ agents (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, …)
Progressive refinement: intent defined before implementation
limitations: Verbose markdown artifacts requiring extensive review
Can feel rigid — 'sledgehammer to crack a nut' for small changes
Designed for new projects, not brownfield refactoring
No built-in git worktree management; branch-based workflow assumes linear development
